text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Japanese Derby.

The anticipation from the stands for the

showdown between the three members
of BNW is
so strong, it's practically
palpable from the
waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Everyone used to freak out about the
"top two"
but now it's all about BNW...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Pfft. Are they? The Triple Crown is three
races,
and the Satsuki Sho's the only one
done.
choice_data_list: 君の実力が認められた証拠だ
貴方の実力が認められた証拠だよ
choice_data_list_en: It's proof that your ability has been recognized.
It's proof that your abilities have been recognized.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
They may be singing about me now, but
public
opinion can change in the blink of
an eye.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
If I get ahead of myself, there's no way
I'm going
to win against her.

There's no doubt who Narita Taishin is
talking
about.

Winning Ticket—the one who's been
utterly
obsessed with becoming a Derby
champion.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
My goal hasn't changed. I'm gonna win
and show
the world what I'm made of.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Until then, I can't let my guard down.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Well, here I go.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hello, Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hayahide. Where is she?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Not here yet. I think she's planning to
stay in the
waiting room until right
before the start of the
race.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Have you noticed how for these past few
days
she...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hasn't been talking to us? Yeah. She's
probably
doing that to stay focused.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Heh. You really do pay attention to
everything.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
It's just easy to notice when someone as
unhinged
as her suddenly goes dead
quiet.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: But it doesn't matter. I'm going to win.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I could say the same to you.

Thus begins the Classic Triple Crown's
second
race, the Japanese Derby—and
the showdown
between the top three!
